verses.text: Di high priest talk say, “These things na so e be?”
E talk say, “Brothers and papa dem, listen. Di God of glory appear to our papa Abraham, when e dey Mesopotamia, before e live for Haran,
and talk to am say, ‘Leave your land, and your relatives, and come enter land wey I go show you.’
Den e come out of di land of di Chaldaeans and live for Haran. From there, when im papa don die, God move am enter this land, wey una dey live now.
E no give am inheritance inside am, no, not even enough to put im foot on. E promise say e go give am am as possession, and to im seed after am, when e still no get pikin.
God talk like this: say im seed go live as strangers for strange land, and dem go make dem slaves and mistreat dem for 400 years.
‘I go judge di nation wey dem go dey bondage to,’ God talk, ‘and after that dem go come out, and serve me for this place.’
E give am di covenant of circumcision. So Abraham become papa of Isaac, and circumcise am for di eighth day. Isaac become papa of Jacob, and Jacob become papa of di 12 patriarchs.
Di patriarchs, as jealousy catch dem for Joseph, sell am enter Egypt. God dey with am,
and deliver am from all im afflictions, and give am favor and wisdom before Pharaoh, king of Egypt. E make am governor over Egypt and all im house.
Now famine come over all di land of Egypt and Canaan, and great affliction. Our papa dem no find food.
But when Jacob hear say grain dey Egypt, e send our papa dem di first time.
For di second time dem make Joseph known to im brothers, and dem reveal Joseph race to Pharaoh.
Joseph send call Jacob, im papa, and all im relatives, 75 souls.
Jacob go down enter Egypt and e die, imself and our papa dem;
and dem carry dem back to Shechem, and put dem for di tomb wey Abraham buy with silver from Hamor sons for Shechem.
But as di time of di promise wey God swear to Abraham near, di people grow and multiply for Egypt,
until another king rise, wey no know Joseph.
Na im take advantage of our race, and mistreat our papa dem, and force dem to abandon dem babies, so that dem no go stay alive.
For that time Moses born, and e fine well well. Dem raise am three months for im papa house.
When dem abandon am, Pharaoh daughter take am up, raise am as im own son.
Dem train Moses for all di wisdom of di Egyptians. E mighty for im words and works.
But when e reach 40 years old, e come to im heart to visit im brothers, di Israel pikin dem.
As e see one of dem suffer wrong, e defend am, and avenge di one wey dem oppress, strike di Egyptian.
E think say im brothers understand say God, by im hand, dey give dem deliverance; but dem no understand.
Di next day, e appear to dem as dem dey fight, urge dem to make peace again, dey talk say, ‘Men, una be brothers. Why una dey wrong each other?’
But di one wey dey wrong im neighbor push am away, dey talk say, ‘Who make you ruler and judge over us?
You want kill me, as you kill di Egyptian yesterday?’
Moses run because of this word, and become stranger for di land of Midian, wia e become papa of two sons.
When 40 years don full, angel of di Lord appear to am for di wilderness of Mount Sinai, for flame of fire for bush.
When Moses see am, e marvel for di sight. As e near to see, voice of di Lord come,
‘I be di God of your papa dem: di God of Abraham, di God of Isaac, and di God of Jacob.’ Moses tremble, and e no dare look.
Di Lord talk to am say, ‘Remove your sandals from your feet, because di place wia you stand na holy ground.
I don surely see di affliction of my people wey dey Egypt, and I don hear dem groaning, and I don come down to deliver dem. Now come, I go send you enter Egypt.’
This Moses, wey dem refuse, dey talk say, ‘Who make you ruler and judge?’ na am God send to be both ruler and deliverer by di hand of di angel wey appear to am for di bush.
This man lead dem out, as e don do wonders and signs for Egypt, for di Red Sea, and for di wilderness 40 years.
Na this Moses talk to di Israel pikin dem, ‘God go raise up prophet for una from among una brothers, like me.’
Na this be di one wey dey di assembly for di wilderness with di angel wey talk to am for Mount Sinai, and with our papa dem, wey receive living revelations to give us,
wey our papa dem no gree obey, but dem reject am, and turn back for dem heart go Egypt,
dey talk to Aaron say, ‘Make gods for us wey go go before us, because as for this Moses, wey lead us out of di land of Egypt, we no know wetin don happen to am.’
Dem make calf for those days, and bring sacrifice to di idol, and rejoice for di works of dem hands.
But God turn, give dem up to serve di army of di sky, as e dey write for di book of di prophets, ‘You offer me slain animals and sacrifices 40 years for di wilderness, O house of Israel?
You carry di tabernacle of Moloch, di star of your god Rephan, di figures wey una make to worship. I go carry una go beyond Babylon.’
Our papa dem get di tabernacle of di testimony for di wilderness, just as di one wey talk to Moses command am to make am according to di pattern wey e don see;
wey our papa dem too, for dem turn, bring enter with Joshua when dem enter di possession of di nations wey God drive out before our papa dem, reach di days of David,
wey find favor before God, and ask to find place to live for di God of Jacob.
But Solomon build house for am.
But di Most High no dey live for temples wey dem make with hands, as di prophet talk,
‘Heaven na my throne, and di earth na footstool for my feet. Wetin kind house una go build for me?’ di Lord talk; ‘or wetin be di place of my rest?
No be my hand make all these things?’
You wey get stiff neck and uncircumcised heart and ears, una always dey resist Holy Spirit! As una papa dem do, na so una dey do.
Which of di prophets una papa dem no persecute? Dem kill di people wey talk before about di coming of di Righteous One, wey una don become betrayers and murderers of now.
Una receive di law as angels order am, and una no keep am!”
Now when dem hear these things, e cut dem for heart, and dem grind dem teeth for am.
But e, as Holy Spirit full am, look up steadily enter heaven, see God glory, and Jesus dey stand for di right hand of God,
and talk say, “Look, I see di heavens open, and di Son of Man dey stand for di right hand of God!”
But dem shout with loud voice, close dem ears, and rush am with one mind.
Dem throw am out of di city, and stone am. Di witnesses put dem clothes for di feet of one young man wey im name na Saul.
Dem stone Stephen as e dey call, dey talk say, “Lord Jesus, receive my spirit!”
E kneel down, shout with loud voice, “Lord, no hold this sin against dem!” When e don talk this, e sleep.
Saul agree with im death. Great persecution rise against di assembly wey dey Jerusalem for that day. Dem all scatter through di regions of Judea and Samaria, except di apostles.
Devout men bury Stephen, and mourn well well over am.
But Saul dey destroy di assembly, dey enter every house, drag both men and women go prison.
So di people wey scatter dey go round dey preach di word.
Philip go down to di city of Samaria, and proclaim Christ to dem.
Di crowds listen with one mind to di things wey Philip talk, when dem hear and see di signs wey e do.
Because evil spirits come out of plenty of di people wey get dem, dey shout with loud voice, and plenty wey paralyze and lame heal.
Great joy dey for that city.
But one man dey, Simon by name, wey dey practice sorcery for di city, and dey amaze di people of Samaria, dey make imself like somebody great,
wey dem all listen to, from di least reach di greatest, dey talk say, “This man na di great power of God.”
Dem dey listen to am, because for long time e don dey amaze dem with im sorceries.
But when dem believe Philip as e dey preach Good News about God Kingdom and di name of Jesus Christ, dem baptize dem, both men and women.
Simon imself believe too. As dem baptize am, e continue with Philip. As e see signs and great miracles dey happen, e marvel.
Now when di apostles wey dey Jerusalem hear say Samaria don receive God word, dem send Peter and John to dem,
wey, when dem come down, pray for dem, so that dem go receive Holy Spirit;
because e never fall on any of dem. Dem just baptize dem for di name of Lord Jesus.
Den dem put dem hands on dem, and dem receive Holy Spirit.
Now when Simon see say through di laying on of di apostles hands dem give Holy Spirit, e offer dem money,
dey talk say, “Give me this power too, so that anybody wey I put my hands on go receive Holy Spirit.”
But Peter talk to am say, “Make your silver perish with you, because you think say you fit get God gift with money!
You no get part or share for this matter, because your heart no right before God.
So repent from this your wickedness, and pray to di Lord say perhaps dem go forgive di thought of your heart.
Because I see say you dey inside bitter poison and bondage of iniquity.”
Simon answer, “Pray for me to di Lord, so that none of di things wey you talk go come on me.”
So dem, when dem don testify and talk di word of di Lord, return to Jerusalem, and preach di Good News to many villages of di Samaritans.
But angel of di Lord talk to Philip, dey talk say, “Get up, go towards di south to di road wey dey go down from Jerusalem to Gaza.” This na desert.
E get up go; and look, one man of Ethiopia dey, eunuch wey get great authority under Candace, queen of di Ethiopians, wey dey over all im treasure, wey come Jerusalem to worship.
E dey return dey sit for im chariot, dey read di prophet Isaiah.
Di Spirit talk to Philip say, “Go near, join yourself to this chariot.”
Philip run to am, hear am dey read Isaiah di prophet, talk say, “You understand wetin you dey read?”
E talk say, “How I go fit, unless somebody explain am to me?” E beg Philip make e come up sit with am.
Now di passage of di Scripture wey e dey read na this, “Dem lead am like sheep go slaughter. As lamb dey quiet before di one wey dey shear am, na so e no dey open im mouth.
For im humiliation, dem take away im judgment. Who go declare im generation? Because dem take im life from di earth.”
Di eunuch answer Philip, “I beg you, tell me, who di prophet dey talk about? About imself, or about somebody else?”
Philip open im mouth, and begin from this Scripture, preach Jesus to am.
As dem dey go for di way, dem come reach one water; and di eunuch talk say, “Look, water dey here. Wetin dey stop me make dem baptize me?”
Philip talk say, “If you believe with all your heart, e fit.” E answer, “I believe say Jesus Christ na God Pikin.”
E command di chariot make e stand still, and dem both go down enter di water, both Philip and di eunuch, and e baptize am.
When dem come up out of di water, di Spirit of di Lord carry Philip go, and di eunuch no see am again, because e go im way dey rejoice.
But dem find Philip for Azotus. As e dey pass through, e preach di Good News to all di cities, until e reach Caesarea.
But Saul, wey still dey breathe threats and slaughter against di disciples of di Lord, go meet di high priest,
ask for letters from am to di synagogues of Damascus, so that if e find any wey belong to di Way, whether men or women, e go bring dem tie go Jerusalem.
As e dey travel, e happen say e near Damascus, and suddenly light from di sky shine round am.
E fall for ground, hear voice dey talk to am say, “Saul, Saul, why you dey persecute me?”
E talk say, “Who you be, Lord?” Lord talk say, “I be Jesus, wey you dey persecute. E hard for you to kick against di goads.”
As e dey tremble and marvel e talk say, “Lord, wetin you want make I do?” Lord talk to am say, “Get up, enter di city, and dem go tell you wetin you must do.”
Di men wey travel with am stand dey speechless, dey hear di voice, but dem no see anybody.
Saul get up from di ground, and when im eyes open, e no see anybody. Dem lead am by di hand, bring am enter Damascus.
E no see for three days, and e no chop or drink.
Now one disciple dey for Damascus, wey im name na Ananias. Lord talk to am for vision, “Ananias!” E talk say, “Look, na me, Lord.”
Lord talk to am say, “Get up, go di street wey dem call Straight, and ask for Judas house for one man wey im name na Saul, man of Tarsus. Because look, e dey pray,
and for vision e don see one man wey im name na Ananias dey come in, and dey put im hands on am, so that e go receive im sight.”
But Ananias answer, “Lord, I don hear from many about this man, how much evil e do to your saints for Jerusalem.
Here e get authority from di chief priests to tie all di people wey call your name.”
But Lord talk to am say, “Go your way, because e be my chosen vessel to carry my name before di nations and kings, and di Israel pikin dem.
Because I go show am how many things e must suffer for my name sake.”

Ananias go, enter di house. As e put im hands on am, e talk say, “Brother Saul, Lord, wey appear to you for di way wey you come, don send me, so that you go receive your sight, and Holy Spirit go full you.”
At once something like scales fall from im eyes, and e receive im sight. E get up and dem baptize am.
E take food and e get strength. Saul stay several days with di disciples wey dey Damascus.
At once for di synagogues e proclaim Jesus, say e na God Pikin.
All wey hear am marvel, dey talk say, “No be this di one wey for Jerusalem destroy di people wey call this name? And e come here to bring dem tie go meet di chief priests!”
But Saul increase more for strength, and confuse di Jews wey dey live for Damascus, dey prove say this na di Christ.
When many days don full, di Jews plan together to kill am,
but dem plot become known to Saul. Dem dey watch di gates both day and night so that dem go kill am,
but im disciples take am for night, let am down through di wall, lower am inside basket.
When Saul reach Jerusalem, e try join di disciples; but dem all fear am, dem no believe say e be disciple.
But Barnabas take am, bring am to di apostles, declare to dem how e see Lord for di way, and say Lord talk to am, and how for Damascus e preach boldly for di name of Jesus.
E dey with dem as dem dey enter and dey go out for Jerusalem,
dey preach boldly for di name of Lord Jesus. E talk and argue against di Hellenists, but dem dey look for way to kill am.
When di brothers know am, dem bring am down go Caesarea, and send am go Tarsus.
So di assemblies through all Judea and Galilee and Samaria get peace, and dem build dem up. Dem multiply, dey waka for di fear of di Lord and for di comfort of Holy Spirit.
As Peter dey go through all those parts, e come down to di saints wey dey live for Lydda too.
For there e find one man wey im name na Aeneas, wey don dey bedridden for eight years because e paralyze.
Peter talk to am say, “Aeneas, Jesus Christ dey heal you. Get up, make your bed!” At once e get up.
All wey dey live for Lydda and for Sharon see am, and dem turn to di Lord.
Now one disciple dey for Joppa wey im name na Tabitha, wey when dem translate am, mean Dorcas. This woman full of good works and acts of mercy wey e dey do.
E happen for those days say e sick, and die. When dem don wash am, dem put am for upper room.
As Lydda near Joppa, di disciples, as dem hear say Peter dey there, send two men to am, dey beg am make e no delay to come to dem.
Peter get up go with dem. When e come, dem bring am enter di upper room. All di widows stand near am dey cry, dey show di coats and clothes wey Dorcas make while e dey with dem.
Peter put dem all out, kneel down pray. As e turn to di body, e talk say, “Tabitha, get up!” E open im eyes, and when e see Peter, e sit up.
E give am im hand, raise am up. As e call di saints and widows, e present am alive.
E become known through all Joppa, and many believe Lord.
E happen say e stay many days for Joppa with one Simon, tanner.
Now one man dey for Caesarea, Cornelius by name, centurion of wetin dem call di Italian Regiment,
devout man, wey fear God with all im house, wey dey give many gifts to di needy among di people, and dey always pray to God.
About di ninth hour of di day, e see clearly for vision angel of God dey come to am, dey talk to am say, “Cornelius!”
E fix im eyes on am, as fear catch am, talk say, “Wetin be am, Lord?” E talk to am say, “Your prayers and your gifts to di needy don go up as memorial before God.
Now send men go Joppa, bring Simon, wey dem name Peter.
E dey stay with one Simon, tanner, wey im house dey by di seaside.”
When di angel wey talk to am don go, e call two of im household servants, and one devout soldier from di ones wey dey wait on am always.
As e don explain everything to dem, e send dem go Joppa.
Di next day, as dem dey on dem journey, and near di city, Peter go up di housetop to pray about di sixth hour.
Hunger catch am and e want chop, but while dem dey prepare, e fall inside trance.
E see heaven open and one container dey come down to am, like big sheet wey dem lower by four corners for di earth,
wey get all kinds of four-footed animals of di earth, wild animals, reptiles, and birds of di sky.
Voice come to am, “Get up, Peter, kill and chop!”
But Peter talk say, “No be so, Lord; because I never chop anything wey common and unclean.”
Voice come to am again di second time, “Wetin God don make clean, you must no call am unclean.”
Dem do this three times, and at once dem take di container up enter di sky.
Now while Peter dey confuse well for imself wetin di vision wey e see fit mean, look, di men wey Cornelius send, as dem don ask for Simon house, stand before di gate,
call and ask whether Simon, wey dem name Peter, dey stay there.
While Peter dey think about di vision, di Spirit talk to am say, “Look, three men dey look for you.
But get up, go down, go with dem, no doubt anything; because na me send dem.”
Peter go down to di men, talk say, “Look, na me una dey look for. Why una come?”
Dem talk say, “Cornelius, centurion, righteous man and one wey fear God, wey di whole nation of di Jews talk well about, holy angel direct am to invite you to im house, and to hear words from you.”
So e call dem enter and lodge dem. Di next day Peter get up go with dem, and some of di brothers from Joppa go with am.
Di next day, dem enter Caesarea. Cornelius dey wait for dem, as e don call im relatives and im close friends together.
When Peter enter, Cornelius meet am, fall down for im feet, and worship am.
But Peter lift am up, dey talk say, “Stand up! Me too na man.”
As e dey talk with am, e enter, and find many people gather together.
E talk to dem say, “Una know say e dey against di law for Jew to join imself or come to person of another nation, but God don show me say I no suppose call any man unholy or unclean.
So I come without complaint when dem send for me. I dey ask for wetin reason una send for me.”
Cornelius talk say, “Four days ago, I dey fast until this hour, and for di ninth hour, I pray for my house, and look, one man stand before me with bright clothes,
and talk say, ‘Cornelius, dem don hear your prayer, and dem remember your gifts to di needy before God.
So send go Joppa, call Simon, wey dem name Peter. E dey stay for di house of Simon, tanner, by di seaside. When e come, e go talk to you.’
So I send to you at once, and e good say you come. Now we all dey here before God, to hear all things wey God command you.”
Peter open im mouth talk say, “Truly I perceive say God no dey show favoritism;
but for every nation di person wey fear am and dey do righteousness dey acceptable to am.
Di word wey e send to di Israel pikin dem, dey preach Good News of peace by Jesus Christ—e be Lord of all—
una know wetin happen, wey dem proclaim through all Judea, begin from Galilee, after di baptism wey John preach;
even Jesus of Nazareth, how God anoint am with Holy Spirit and with power, wey dey go about dey do good, and dey heal all wey di devil oppress, because God dey with am.
We be witnesses of everything wey e do both for di country of di Jews, and for Jerusalem; wey dem kill too, hang am for tree.
God raise am up for di third day, and give am to dey revealed,
no be to all di people, but to witnesses wey God choose before, to us, wey chop and drink with am after e rise from di dead.
E command us to preach to di people, and to testify say na this one God appoint as Judge of di living and di dead.
To am all di prophets testify say through im name everybody wey believe am go receive forgiveness of sins.”
While Peter still dey talk these words, Holy Spirit fall on all di people wey hear di word.
Di believers of di circumcision marvel, as many as come with Peter, because dem pour di gift of Holy Spirit on di Gentiles too.
Because dem hear dem dey talk other languages and dey praise God. Den Peter answer,
“Anybody fit stop di water, so that these ones wey don receive Holy Spirit like us no go dey baptized?”
E command say make dem baptize dem for di name of Jesus Christ. Den dem ask am to stay some days.
Now di apostles and di brothers wey dey Judea hear say di Gentiles don receive God word too.
When Peter come up to Jerusalem, di people of di circumcision argue with am,
dey talk say, “You enter go meet uncircumcised men, and chop with dem!”
But Peter begin, explain to dem in order, dey talk say,
“I dey di city of Joppa dey pray, and for trance I see vision, one container dey come down, like big sheet wey dem lower from di sky by four corners. E reach me.
When I look am well, I consider, and see di four-footed animals of di earth, wild animals, creeping things, and birds of di sky.
I hear voice dey talk to me say, ‘Get up, Peter, kill and chop!’
But I talk say, ‘No be so, Lord, because nothing common or unclean don ever enter my mouth.’
But voice answer me di second time from heaven, ‘Wetin God don make clean, you must no call am unclean.’
Dem do this three times, and all dem pull up again enter di sky.
Look, at once three men stand before di house wia I dey, wey dem send from Caesarea to me.
Di Spirit tell me make I go with dem, without hesitating. These six brothers go with me too, and we enter di man house.
E tell us how e see di angel dey stand for im house, dey talk to am say, ‘Send go Joppa, bring Simon, wey dem name Peter,
wey go talk words to you wey you go dey saved by, you and all your house.’
As I begin to talk, Holy Spirit fall on dem, just as on us for di beginning.
I remember di word of Lord, how e talk say, ‘John baptize with water, but una go dey baptize with Holy Spirit.’
So if God give dem di same gift as e give us too, when we believe Lord Jesus Christ, who I be, wey I go fit stand against God?”
When dem hear these things, dem keep quiet, and dem praise God, dey talk say, “Den God don grant di Gentiles repentance to life too!”
Di people wey scatter because of di oppression wey rise about Stephen travel reach Phoenicia, Cyprus, and Antioch, dey talk di word to nobody except Jews only.
But some of dem dey, men of Cyprus and Cyrene, wey, when dem reach Antioch, talk to di Hellenists, dey preach Lord Jesus.
Di hand of di Lord dey with dem, and great number believe and turn to di Lord.
Di report about dem reach di ears of di assembly wey dey Jerusalem. Dem send Barnabas go reach Antioch,
wey, when e come, and see di grace of God, e glad. E urge dem all say make dem remain near di Lord with purpose of heart.
Because e be good man, full of Holy Spirit and of faith. Many people join Lord.
Barnabas go Tarsus to look for Saul.
When e find am, e bring am to Antioch. E happen say for one whole year dem gather with di assembly, and teach many people. Di disciples first dey called Christians for Antioch.
For these days, prophets come down from Jerusalem to Antioch.
One of dem wey im name na Agabus stand up, show by di Spirit say great famine go dey all over di world, wey happen for di days of Claudius too.
As any of di disciples get plenty, each of dem decide to send relief to di brothers wey dey live for Judea;
wey dem do too, dey send am to di elders by di hand of Barnabas and Saul.
Now about that time, Herod di king stretch out im hands to oppress some of di assembly.
E kill James, John brother, with sword.
When e see say e please di Jews, e go on to catch Peter too. Na di days of unleavened bread.
When e catch am, e put am for prison, deliver am to four groups of four soldiers to guard am, as e wan bring am out to di people after di Passover.
So dem keep Peter for di prison, but di assembly dey pray to God for am constantly.
Di same night when Herod dey about to bring am out, Peter dey sleep between two soldiers, wey dem tie with two chains. Guards for front of di door dey keep di prison.
Look, angel of di Lord stand near, and light shine for di cell. E strike Peter side, wake am, dey talk say, “Get up quick!” Im chains fall off from im hands.
Di angel talk to am say, “Dress and put on your sandals.” E do so. E talk to am say, “Put on your cloak, and follow me.”
E go out follow am. E no know say wetin di angel do na real, but e think say e dey see vision.
When dem don pass di first and di second guard, dem reach di iron gate wey dey lead enter di city, wey open for dem by itself. Dem go out, pass through one street, and at once di angel leave am.
When Peter come to imself, e talk say, “Now I truly know say di Lord don send out im angel and deliver me from di hand of Herod, and from everything wey di Jewish people dey expect.”
As e consider this, e come to di house of Mary, John mama, wey dem name Mark, wia many people gather dey pray.
When Peter knock di door of di gate, one maid wey im name na Rhoda come answer.
When e know Peter voice, e no open di gate because of joy, but run enter, report say Peter dey stand before di gate.
Dem talk to am say, “You don craze!” But e insist say na so e be. Dem talk say, “Na im angel.”
But Peter continue to knock. When dem open, dem see am, and dem marvel.
But e wave hand to dem make dem keep quiet, declare to dem how di Lord bring am out of di prison. E talk say, “Tell these things to James and to di brothers.” E leave, go another place.
Now as soon as day break, no small stir dey among di soldiers about wetin don happen to Peter.
When Herod look for am, and no find am, e examine di guards, command say make dem kill dem. E go down from Judea go Caesarea, and stay there.

Now Herod vex well well with di people of Tyre and Sidon. Dem come to am with one mind, and as dem don make Blastus, di king chamberlain, dem friend, dem ask for peace, because dem country dey depend on di king country for food.
For one appointed day, Herod, wey wear royal clothes, sit for di throne, give speech to dem.
Di people shout, “Di voice of god, no be of man!”
At once angel of di Lord strike am, because e no give God di glory. Worms chop am and e die.
But God word grow and multiply.
Barnabas and Saul return from Jerusalem when dem don finish dem service, dey carry John wey dem name Mark with dem too.
